name: ChoiceMate AI Product Finder
author: velocityplugins

sections.description:
ChoiceMate AI helps customers discover the right products faster. It builds personalized question flows per product category and recommends the best matches based on the shopper’s answers. No external CDNs are used; all assets load via WordPress core for maximum stability.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Question Generation: Automatically generates relevant questions based on your product data
  • Category-Specific Assistants: Each product category gets its own tailored question tree
  • Smart Product Matching: Advanced algorithms recommend the best products based on customer preferences
  • Conversion Analytics: Track completion rates, conversions, and customer preferences
  • Admin-Friendly: Dashboard to manage flows, generate questions, and track results
  • Mobile Optimized: Responsive design works perfectly on all devices
  • WooCommerce Native: Built for WooCommerce, HPOS compatible
  • Privacy & Stability: No external CDNs; uses WordPress wp-element and native fetch

How It Works

  1. AI Analysis: Scans products to detect key characteristics (price, brand, attributes)
  2. Question Trees: Generates relevant questions per category (editable)
  3. Customer Journey: Customers answer 3-5 simple questions about their needs
  4. Smart Recommendations: Personalized recommendations with clear “why this product” reasons
  5. Increased Conversions: Customers find exactly what they need, faster

Perfect For

  • Stores with complex product catalogs
  • Categories where customers need guidance (electronics, furniture, clothing)
  • Shops wanting to reduce support requests
  • Store owners looking to increase conversions

External services

This plugin connects to OpenAI’s API to generate intelligent product recommendation questions and analyze customer preferences.

OpenAI API Integration:
– What it’s used for: Generating personalized question trees for product categories and analyzing product data to create relevant customer questions
– Data sent: Product information (names, descriptions, attributes, prices) from your WooCommerce store, and customer answers to recommendation questions
– When data is sent: When administrators generate new question trees for product categories, and when customers use the recommendation widget
– Service provider: OpenAI (https://openai.com)
– Terms of Service: https://openai.com/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy/

The plugin requires an OpenAI API key to function. No data is sent to OpenAI without your explicit configuration and API key setup.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/choicemate-ai/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Configure your AI settings in ChoiceMate AI → Settings
  4. Generate question trees for your product categories (or enable Auto‑generate for new categories)
  5. Start converting more customers!

Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes anywhere:

  • Widget on any page: [choicemate_widget category_id="123"]
  • Alternative finder button: [choicemate_alternative_finder]
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. Enter it under ChoiceMate AI → Settings. You can get one at openai.com.

Which WooCommerce versions are supported?

WooCommerce 7.0+ and HPOS.

Can I customize the questions?

Yes. AI generates a first version which you can edit, reorder or regenerate.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. The widget is fully responsive and optimized for mobile.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Replaced all external CDNs with WordPress core wp-element
  • Improved recommendations: parent-category fallback, robust empty-result handling
  • Enhanced match reasons (brand, platform, price budget)
  • Fixed admin links and improved analytics time windows
  • Added optional auto‑generation for new product categories
  • Production‑safe logging (respects WP_DEBUG)

1.0.0

  • Initial release with AI question generation, matching, analytics and admin UI
